question: How did the English King Charles II originally acquire the island of Bombay in 1661?
options: By defeating the French in the Battle of Wandiwash
As part of the royal dowry when he married the Portuguese princess Catherine of Braganza
Through a direct purchase treaty from the Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb
By signing a commercial treaty with the Maratha ruler Shivaji
explanation: In 1661, the Portuguese crown ceded the island and harbor of Bombay to the English King Charles II as part of the dowry for his marriage to Catherine of Braganza, the sister of King Alphonso VI of Portugal.

question: In which year did King Charles II transfer the island of Bombay to the English East India Company for a nominal annual rent of 10 pounds?
explanation: King Charles II found it difficult to govern Bombay directly and transferred the island to the East India Company in 1668 for an annual rent of 10 pounds in gold.
